# pcd_keymanager_secret (Resource)

Manages a secret in PCD's Barbican key manager. Secrets are immutable — any change forces a new resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_keymanager_secret" "example" {
  name                 = "tf-example-passphrase"
  secret_type          = "passphrase"
  payload              = "super-secret-value"
  payload_content_type = "text/plain"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `algorithm` (String) The encryption algorithm (e.g. aes). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `bit_length` (Number) The bit length of the secret. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `expiration` (String) Expiration timestamp (RFC3339). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `mode` (String) The cipher mode (e.g. cbc). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) The name of the secret. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `payload` (String, Sensitive) The secret data. Write-only: never read back from the server. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `payload_content_encoding` (String) The payload content encoding (e.g. base64 for binary payloads). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `payload_content_type` (String) The payload content type (required when payload is set, e.g. text/plain). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `secret_type` (String) The secret type: symmetric, public, private, passphrase, certificate, or opaque (default). Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `content_types` (Map of String) The content types the secret is available in.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `creator_id` (String) The ID of the user that created the secret.
- `id` (String) The secret UUID.
- `secret_ref` (String) The full Barbican secret reference URL.
- `status` (String) The secret status (e.g. ACTIVE).
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_keymanager_secret.example <id>
```
